items.docs:
This Endpoint allows Merchants to initiate a refund for a Checkout transaction.

**Webhook:** ✅ Supported (requires Coins' configuration)

params.name: refundId
params.description: Coins-generated refund ID. At least one of `refundId` or `requestId` must be provided.

params.name: requestId
params.description: Merchant refund request ID (idempotency key). At least one of `refundId` or `requestId` must be provided.

params.name: recvWindow
params.description: Validity duration of the request in milliseconds after the timestamp.

items.docs: This Endpoint allows Merchants to query the status of a Checkout refund by either `refundId` or `requestId`. At least one of the two must be provided.
